name: Nanolife
source:
While a thunderstorm rages outside, a boy excitedly boots up a new MMORPG for the first time. After fiddling around with the character creator for a while he's finally ready to play with his new character. However, just as he's about to press the submit button, lighting strikes!

As a result of the lightning strike the power goes out, and he's forced to sit and wait in frustration. What he doesn't realize is that his character has already begun playing without him...

[From [url=http://pegasi.weeaboo.nl/project-nanolife.php]Official site[/url]]
translation:
外面雷雨交加，一个男孩兴奋地第一次启动了一款新的网络游戏。在角色创建器里捣鼓了一阵后，他终于准备好使用新角色来游戏了。然而，就在他即将按下提交按钮的瞬间，闪电击中了！

雷击导致停电，他不得不沮丧地坐着等待。他没有意识到的是，他的角色已经在没有他的情况下开始了冒险……

[出自[url=http://pegasi.weeaboo.nl/project-nanolife.php]官方网站[/url]]
